checkpoint.title: Pokemon Mansion B1F to the SECRET KEY, out by an Escape Rope

events.why: to (5, 6), above the SECRET KEY (5, 7): the opening (12, 10-12) is open only with the switch on, so the route presses the statue it passes
out to the Mansion's door (pokeguy 1:20:24-36, his ESCAPE ROPE count 3 to 2); the player stands on (8, 4), where 14.01 starts

checkpoint: Starts below TM14's ball, at (23, 5), where 13.03 ends. Ends outside the Mansion door on Cinnabar (8, 4) facing south, where 14.01 starts.

The Mansion's statue switches: one flag for all four floors (pokefirered data/scripts/pokemon_mansion.inc, PokemonMansion_*F scripts.inc), a toggle each press flips and each floor applies on load. The pinned maps (PokemonSimulation 4b886bb) carry it as gates: barriers that open when the switch is on or off, and the statues that press it. A route plans the presses itself (PRESS_SWITCH: face the statue, A, Yes, B through the text) wherever a barrier is in the way, and the step's gates_after says the switch it leaves; a checkpoint that starts from a save says the switch in start_gates.
Not taken: the FULL RESTORE (2F (2, 29)) and TM22 (1F (6, 21)); pokeguy leaves by Escape Rope after the key (1:20:24-36).
